name: Lamb Hand Pies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400˚F
Unroll puff pastry on parchment-lined baking sheet
For each pastry, cut pastry in half vertically to create two 6-inch wide rectangles
Set pastry aside
Cut onions into 1/4 inch pieces
Strip thyme leaves from stems
Mince the garlic
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add 1 tbsp oil, then lambs and half of the onions
Cook breaking up the lamb into smaller pieces until no pink remains, 4-5 minutes
Drain and discard extra fat
Add thyme, mustard, worcestershire, garlic, tomato sauce, and water
Cook stirring often until mixture thickens slightly, 1-2 minutes
Season with salt and pepper
Divide lamb mixture over each of the 4 halves of pastry rectangle
Fold the side of each pastry without the lamb mixture over filling.
Use fingers to pinch the border closed
Make 2-3 small slits in the top of the pastry with a knife
Bake pies on the middle rack until pastry is golden-brown and cooked through, 25-28 minutes
Meanwhile, heat a small pot over medium heat
When hot, add grapes, remaining onions, half the vinegar, and half the butter
Cook stirring often until grapes burst and chutney thickens slightly, 5-6 minutes
Cut cucumber into 1/4 inch rounds
Whisk together vinegar, 2 tbsp oil, sugar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl
Add spring mix, cucumbers to dressing; toss to combine
To serve, place cooked lamb pies on plate, top with chutney and add salad to the side
